name: Lamborghini Diablo (1990, the first rear-drive car: pop-up head lamps, no rear wing)
axes: mm; x from the nose tip (0) back to the tail (4460); y half-width from the centre line (symmetric, positive); z from the ground at static ride height

tolerance.overall: makers' figures: exact (length, width, height, wheelbase, tracks, tyres)
tolerance.overhangs: +-30: read on the GT/GTR drawings (952 and 930 front for 4430 long cars with their own bumpers), set to 1000/810 for the 4460 long 1990 car
tolerance.profile: +-25 in z, +-30 in x: read on the kit side drawing (4.07 mm/px, isotropic)
tolerance.plan: +-30: read on the blueprint plan (about 10.2 mm/px along, 10.4 across) and the kit plan (4.2 mm/px along, 3.9 across)
tolerance.parts: +-40; the 1990 car's own parts (pop-up lamps, bumpers, tail band, engine cover louvres, wheels) are from memory of the car and the 3D model picture, placed on the measured body: +-60

sources: makers' data: length 4460, width 2040, height 1105, wheelbase 2650, tracks 1540/1640, tyres 245/40 ZR17 and 335/35 ZR17 on 8.5x17 and 13x17 wheels

kit instruction sheet, Diablo GT, four line views (kit_4view.png): side read for the profile, the glass, the door, the creases; plan read for the screen, roof, glass, ridges; its front and rear views are perspective drawings (used for layout only)
the-blueprints.com Diablo GTR 4-view (blueprint_gtr.png): plan half-widths, front and rear outline; core body only (the race kit ignored)
a 3D model of a Diablo VT/SV with the lamps raised, panel edges shown (model_3dsmax.png): how the body splits into panels

drawingChecks._: how each drawing was scaled, and what was found (the lesson of eb110.json corrections_138: check before trusting one scale)
drawingChecks.kitSide: wheel centres found by circle fit at px (301.8, 1087) and (952.2, 1085.8): wheelbase 650.4 px = 2650 -> 4.074 mm/px; front tyre radius 78 px = 318 mm (real 314): isotropic within 2 %, no correction; ground row 1165
drawingChecks.kitPlan: photographed at an angle: 4.2 mm/px along (nose px 70 to tail px 1125 = 4430), 3.9 mm/px across (widest 2040), centre line tilted (row 470 at the nose, 445 at the tail); widths read with the cross scale
drawingChecks.kitFrontRear: perspective (the near end larger): not measured
drawingChecks.blueprintSide: wheel centres px 128.5 and 392.5: 10.04 mm/px along; tyres 62 px wide and 60 px tall (round within 3 %), roof 108 px above the ground = 1084 at that scale against 1115 real: squashed about 3 % in z (not 18 %); z scaled by the height (10.3 mm/px)
drawingChecks.blueprintPlan: centre row 360, widest half 98 px = 1020 -> 10.41 mm/px across; nose px 35, tail px 470
drawingChecks.gtVs1990: the GT and GTR have their own bumpers (shorter nose), fixed lamps, wide arches, a roof scoop and a wing: none carried over; the body between the axles and the upper lines are common

profile._: the silhouette from the side as a polyline [x, z]: straight runs, the joints rounded over 20-60 mm only

runs.nose: 0-50: the lip, tip line at z 340
runs.screen: 900-1780 at 21 degrees (centre line; the corners' foot at x 1150)
runs.ridge: 2690-4330 falling 6-10 degrees (the buttress ridges; the engine cover lies 110-10 below, see edges.engineCover)
runs.tail: 4330-4384 leaning back 10 degrees down to z 600, then the bumper

profile.wedge: nose tip to screen top: 0/340 to 1780/1056, the bonnet within 60 of that line

plan._: half-width at x at the widest line (mirrors excluded); the nose square with round corners, widest over the rear wheels
plan.ridge: the roof's edge runs straight back as the buttress ridge: outer edge y 490 at 2690, 505 at 3000, 560 at 3400, 700 at 4000, 790 at 4330; inner wall y 458
plan.glassFoot: y 867 at 1150 (the wing), 757 at 1400, 775 at 2000, 800 at 2500: 170 inboard of the widest line along the door (kit plan 776, blueprint 750)

edges._: the lines along the flank, [x, z]
edges.doorTopKink: the glass's foot drops from the wing's crest (768 at x 1150) to its lowest, 700 at x 1400 behind the mirror, then climbs 0.105 per mm to 810 at the door's back edge
edges.ledge: from the glass's foot out and down to the flank's top edge 120 outboard and 36 lower (a 17 degree shelf), then a rounded shoulder 50 wide to the crease
edges.noseLine: the bumper's top line round the nose at z 340 (a shut line from arch to arch)

rear.shape: Gandini: a cut polygon, raked front leg, flat top, steeper back

panels._: 15 volumes (plan 81 section 3), each its own surface, sharing border points
panels.1_frontBumper: x 0-640 below the nose line z 340: lamp strip z 262-300, three intakes z 160-250, chin z 105-135
panels.2_bonnet: the lid: flat, x 185-1108, half-width 430; ahead of the screen a black cowl 1108-1150
panels.3_lampCovers: x 215-485, y 450-770 each side, on the 28 degree slope; hinge at the back edge, 31 degrees up
panels.4_frontWings: from the nose round to the door's front edge x 1470; crest 50 in from the widest line
panels.5_cabin: screen 900/1150-1780/1840, pillars leaning in 45 degrees, roof 1840-2690 half-width 490; interior: dash, tunnel, two seats, wheel
panels.6_doors: x 1470-2560, from the glass's foot to the scoop's top edge z 310-430; scissor doors, closed
panels.7_sills: z 110-310 under the doors, the scoop pressed in from x 2450
panels.8_rearQuarters: x 2560-4330: the widest shoulder, the rear arch, the lower intake
panels.9_buttresses: the ridge from the roof's corner to the tail, and the slope outboard of it (quarter glass, upper intake)
panels.10_engineCover: between the ridges, half-width 450, x 2725-4150; louvres two banks of 7; a short deck behind it to 4330
panels.11_tailPanel: x 4330 at the top leaning back to 4384 at z 600; the black band z 650-848 sunk 30
panels.12_rearBumper: z 336-612, standing 70 proud, rear face at x 4456; valance z 185-336 with the grille and pipes
panels.13_floor: flat at z 110; wheel wells dark, inner walls at y 600/610
panels.14_wheels: OZ five-hole, 17 in; rear much wider
panels.15_wing: optional (wing = 1): blade x 4130-4430 at z 1104-1132, span 1760, two struts at y 572
